_note: Proven concepts, each taken from a listing observed selling on eBay UK on 30 Aug 2026. A concept is applied ACROSS a whole subject bank, which is what turns 1,100 animals into 1,100 pictures that genuinely differ. See pod/RESEARCH_WHAT_SELLS.md for the evidence.

concepts.title: {subject} In A {outfit} Art Print {era} Animal Portrait Wall Art A4 A3
